description: This file defines the API class 'MyTimesheetItemAPI' for handling REST actions related to a user's timesheet entries within the OrangeHRM system. It includes API documentation annotations, extends a base class, and overrides a method to retrieve a specific timesheet by ID, verifying user permissions.

classes.name: OrangeHRM\Time\Api\MyTimesheetItemAPI
classes.description: API class for managing individual timesheet entries belonging to the authenticated user, extending functionality from EmployeeTimesheetItemAPI, including retrieval and permission checks for timesheets.

methods.name: getTimesheet
methods.description: Retrieves a specific timesheet by ID from request parameters, verifies user access rights, and throws an exception if not authorized or the timesheet doesn't exist.
